title: What Is Varicose Vein Surgery?
description: What varicose vein surgery (varicose vein treatment) is, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: Varicose vein treatment removes or closes the dilated leg veins that cause discomfort and risk. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Varicose vein treatment removes or closes the dilated leg veins that cause discomfort and risk.

How is it done?

Endovenous laser, radiofrequency, sclerotherapy or surgery (saphenectomy), depending on the case.

When is it indicated?

Symptomatic varicose veins, venous insufficiency or complications (ulcers, phlebitis). The specialist decides.
